name: event_id
description: nullable on purpose, a record can fail precisely because it has no id

name: schema_version
description: version the producer claimed, often the thing that went wrong

name: quarantined_ts
description: when we rejected it, used for partitioning

name: violation_codes
description: flat list of codes so you can group by failure mode without parsing json

name: violations
description: every violation with its path and detail, the full diagnosis

name: payload
description: the rejected event, kept so it can be replayed once the producer is fixed

name: replayed_at
description: set when this record has been successfully replayed into raw
